exact_statement: For every Boolean core g and edit region E on a uniform cube, with a=g, b=g*(-1)^1_E, J=(I(a)+I(b))/2 and kappa=I((a-b)/2), exactly 2*kappa-J=P_in-P_out, where P_in and P_out are the contributions to I(g) of pivotal edges entirely inside and outside E. Thus half-private kappa<=J/2 holds iff P_in<=P_out, in particular for all independent edit sets and all point edits of arbitrary cores. For point edits in dimension m, delta=2^-m, kappa=m*delta/2 and J>=m*delta. Products of disjoint arbitrary private cores activated through arbitrary masks on two shared bits, with edit densities<=1/2 and P_in<=P_out, have a prescribed z-then-w stopping prefix with T_private<=2*J and exact total derivative charge T=T_private+2*E_zw<=2*J+d<=2*I. For arbitrary edit regions of density<=1/2 the exact signed identity T_private=2*J+W holds, W=sum_j,direction E_other[Q_-j*(P_in-P_out)_j,edge]. Supplied normalized complete four-leaf references of average cost cbar lift to one normalized root reference with CE<=cbar+T+(3/ln2)*d; cbar<=C*J implies CE<=max(C+2,1+3/ln2)*I. An actual two-bit core/edit pair with J=1,kappa=3/4,q=0 refutes the unconditional half-private extension. No universal supply of terminal slack or recursive reference is claimed.

Supplied complete h/s references of costs c_h,c_s admit a normalized full reference with CE<=2+(c_h+c_s)/2. Its raw derivative prefix has T_private=(I(h)+1/2)I(s), T=T_private+P_s({z,w}), and W=T_private-2J. For s=chi_z chi_w and parity h on m bits, W=m, T=2m+2, CE=cbar=2, I=(m+3)/2; the raw sufficient rate4 ledger deficit cbar+T+(3/ln2)d-4I is 3/ln2-2>0 despite zero localized bill. The connected extension with parity on k shared and m private bits has H=CE=2, I=(m+k+1)/2, raw T=km+k^2/2 and zero shared erasure; m=k^2 makes raw T/I unbounded. These refute treating positive W or raw sufficient-ledger failure as necessary stopping/reference debt, not A019's conditional theorem or FEI. Additionally, for any possibly nonbalanced Boolean h and parity on k>=1 shared bits, H(F)=2+H(h)/2 and a supplied normalized complete h reference with cost c_h gives a normalized root reference of CE=2+c_h/2; early shared erasure is zero and final erasure is (1+beta^2)/2*h2(beta^2/(1+beta^2))<=1, with conditional influence1/2. Thus this arbitrary-core parity prefix has zero K2 bad-node bill and conditional rate max(C,4) if c_h<=C I(h). No such core reference is universally supplied.
